name: tiemLenShop
description: Root command runner for Tiệm Len Nhà Kiều independent sources.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,client,admin -c blue,magenta,cyan "npm --prefix api run dev" "npm --prefix fe-client run dev" "npm --prefix fe-admin run dev"
scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:client && npm run build:admin
scripts.install:apps: npm run install:api && npm run install:client && npm run install:admin
